productConcept.name: Wren Ledger
productConcept.description: A documentary genealogical research consultancy that builds authoritative family records from primary archival sources across 38 countries.
productConcept.rationale: The wren-ledger design system's warm parchment palette (#f5f2ee), Archivo serif-inflected display type with 0.06em tracking, and restrained zero-accent-color aesthetic reads as 'self-possessed' and 'scholarly'. The obvious destination (stationery brand) was rejected in favour of archival research practice — a genealogical consultancy that literally maintains ledgers of family history. The name 'Wren Ledger' maps directly: wren as a symbol of careful attention to detail, ledger as the record-keeping artefact central to genealogical documentation.
